steps.title: Define Project Requirements and Metadata Configuration

steps.description: Set up build.gradle with correct compileSdk, minSdk, and targetSdk versions under Java 8 compliance.

steps.title: Declare Application Manifest
steps.description: Define standard Android Manifest with launcher activity and orientation configurations.

steps.title: Setup Theme Colors
steps.description: Specify responsive palette colors in colors.xml for dark modes, operators, and highlights.

steps.title: Declare String Resources
steps.description: Specify local app context variables inside strings.xml resource values.

steps.title: Create Numeric Button Background Selector
steps.description: Configure press state behaviors and rounded corner layouts for standard numeric buttons.

steps.title: Create Operator Button Background Selector
steps.description: Define custom selector styles for operator buttons featuring warm high-visibility colors.

steps.title: Create Special Button Background Selector
steps.description: Define custom selector styles for helper/utility keys.

steps.title: Create Equals Button Background Selector
steps.description: Define a custom high-contrast green selector background for evaluation operations.

steps.title: Create Loader Box Background
steps.description: Specify custom rounded box background parameters to house the progress loader components.

steps.description: Implement modern, layered FrameLayout UI featuring the header panel, main grid layout, history panel, and calculating progress loader overlay.

steps.description: Integrate low-latency ToneGenerator system inside MainActivity.java to deliver instant click sounds on user keypress.

steps.description: Write persistence methods to preserve previous calculation logs across app reboots.

steps.title: Setup Button Actions, Async Loader, & Expression Restores
steps.description: Attach click sound triggers to buttons and establish realistic animated loading processes during evaluations or history deletions.

steps.title: Deploy Parser Logic & Main Entry Structure
steps.description: Finalize robust calculations parser inside MainActivity.java supporting order of operations, decimal formatting, and signs.

steps.title: Building Modern Calculator
steps.description: Compile updated structures via Gradle assembleDebug step.
